verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Drata's API, integrations, monitoring, policy center, and agent architecture, but contains no mention of a dedicated auditor-facing portal, scoped auditor accounts, or evidence-sharing workflow that replaces emailed PDFs. Nothing in the docs list references 'auditor view,' 'audit hub,' or similar auditor collaboration features. missing for 10: documentation of a scoped auditor login/role, an audit workspace UI, evidence-sharing workflow with auditors, any independent or customer account of auditors using the platform directly.
